blocks.content: The rule is ready. In this milestone, you save it and Grafana starts evaluating it on the schedule you set.
Click **Save rule** to save and activate your alert rule. Grafana immediately begins evaluating it at the interval you set.

**Your alert rule is saved and running.** When the condition holds past your pending period, the alert fires and notifications go to your contact point.

You've created a complete alert rule from query to notification.
